episodes.instruction: Use the left arm to pick up the red can, put it into the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, the other arm lifts the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.
Grab the lightweight cylindrical metal can, drop it into the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, lift the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips with another arm.
Use the left arm to put the rounded can with smooth printed surface in the oval basket with medium storage space; the other arm lifts the oval basket with medium storage space.
